title: ValueCloud device snapshot for the same LVYUAN hardware
summary: A ValueCloud device-detail bundle captured alongside the BLE capture reports mains 230.9 V, grid active power 1.23 kW, load active power 1231 W, battery 54.1 V at 0 A and 98 percent SOC, plus monotonic import/load energy counters. These values independently confirm the register interpretation of the local capture.
